notes: §1985:IX.3.2.4 GR6: "The VALUE OF clause for the Indexed I-O module is the same as the VALUE OF clause for the Sequential I-O module": the format VALUE OF {implementor-name-1 IS {data-name-1 | literal-1}} ... (§1985:VII.3.9.2), data-name-1 "cannot be subscripted, nor can data-name-1 be an item described with the USAGE IS INDEX clause" (§1985:VII.3.9.3 SR1) and "must be in the Working-Storage Section" (SR2), and an external connector's clauses must be consistent by rules "The implementor will specify" (§1985:VII.3.9.4 GR2). Since kb/Work PB5070 and PB5300 landed, valueOfClause is valueOfEntry+ (implementor-name-1 before each operand), CaptureValueOf records the entries and ResolveValueOfDataNames applies SR1 and SR2 (COBOL6849, COBOL2024, COBOL1639), CheckFileDescriptions compares an external connector's literal-1 per implementor-name below 2002 (COBOL6847, the determination of docs/conformance/3.7), and VisitValueOfClause refuses the clause from 2002; no label is processed, so GR1 has no run-time effect (docs/conformance/3.7). Probed at --std 85 on an indexed file, 2026-11-14 tree dc1f2dcce8: (b)(d) legal and running: a literal, a WS data-name with and without IS, NM OF G1 (qualified), three entries with a numeric literal and a PIC 9 item, ZERO ("A figurative constant may be used whenever 'literal' appears in a format", §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3), -12, a group holding an INDEX item; refused: unqualified ambiguous NM (COBOL1639), TE (1) and WID (1:2) (COBOL2024), an INDEX item and an unsubscripted table element (COBOL6849), a File Section and a Linkage item (COBOL6849), an undefined name (COBOL1639), no implementor-name, IS with none, two literals for one entry, FUNCTION (COBOL5506/COBOL1970); (a) a WS group with an ODO table is admitted and the ODO record of the file writes and reads back K0012AB; (c) X"41" and N"AB" literal-1 refused (COBOL0900), the clause refused at 2002 and 2023; (e) a READ of a missing key gives INVALID KEY, status 23; external connector in two programs: "AAA" against "BBB" refused (COBOL6847), equal literals and different implementor-names accepted. The prior PARTIAL (operands unchecked) is fixed. The witness is an indexed FD with VALUE OF FILE-ID IS a literal that runs and displays VALUE OF ACCEPTED. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5070 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5070 and kb/Work PB5300 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "The VALUE OF clause for the Indexed I-O module is the same as the VALUE OF clause for the Sequential I-O module."; 2023: "No VALUE OF clause: the 13.4.5 file description entry rules and the clause rules shown never mention it". VALUE OF was obsolete in 1985 and slated for deletion. No 2023 candidate covers it, and the 2023 file description clauses shown (BLOCK, RECORD, CODE-SET, EXTERNAL, GLOBAL) omit it.
